'''Havaal''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] who served as [[Gallo Memm]]'s chief steward. Charged with overseeing the security of [[Streysel Island]], he stayed on [[Vaynai/Legends|Vaynai]] while Memm was away on business.
